purpose: Test downside depth/duration and growth cost of a fixed causal combined gate against its own unchanged base and a fixed half-exposure reference. No predictive-alpha, untouched-test, loss-guarantee or promotion claim.

source.historical_access: already viewed development history; no protected holdout
source.raw_price_signal_policy: Saved unadjusted OHLC rounded to cents before features; dividends separately credited by account ledger; raw-price peaks start at first saved2004close

gate.drawdown: raw close / expanding maximum raw close from saved2004start -1
gate.initial_state: unassessed with zero target until all features ready; then yellow, evaluate immediate worsening and staged green confirmation

recovery.worsening: immediate at completed close; green may go directly red; reset counters on worsening or failed recovery band
recovery.stage_boundary: red-to-yellow close never counts toward green confirmation; green count begins next close
recovery.persistence: keep state when no deterioration/recovery transition applies

gate.target: min(base_target, state_cap * nominal_exposure); do not multiply two sizing reductions
gate.availability: completed close t only; shift state/target once to next saved session open t+1; preserve warmup state into evaluation; new portfolio starts in cash

cases.execution: Buy maximum whole shares under99%initialsizingreserve at first evaluation open with modeled costs. Hold thereafter, cash dividends accumulate; no discretionary rebalance or dividend reinvestment. Preserve shared mandatory margin/halt checks.

account.rebalance: Daily next-open targets for five target-based cases, including always-long daily. Entry-only buy/hold explicitly holds initial shares without discretionary rebalancing.
account.dividends: same saved ex-date cash dividend ledger policy
account.terminal: mark holdings at final close; no extra terminal liquidation

evaluation.growth_cost: CAGR difference in percentage points and ending equity versus each own base and half-exposure reference; no chosen acceptable sacrifice
evaluation.same_base_hypothesis: For each gated/base pair, gate is no worse on both primary metrics and strictly better on at least one; otherwise reject this joint protective-path claim in that cost context
evaluation.cost_robustness: A claim surviving costs must satisfy its specified comparisons in both5bp and10bp contexts; never pool contexts
evaluation.additional_claim_boundary: Fixed half exposure is not an exact matched-risk control; protective alpha or general timing superiority stays unassessed even if both primary metrics improve
evaluation.block_boundaries: Read continuous full-path ledgers; no refit, state reset, artificial liquidation or capital restart. Prior saved close anchors block returns and within-block DD; full-path DD remains separate. All blocks already viewed.

warning_event.start: first executed green-to-yellow/red state transition; one episode until green returns
warning_event.price_event: any raw SPY close <=95% of executed-session open across that day and next20sessions
warning_event.actionable_warning: separately record first day within each episode where gated intended target is below its own ungated base target; no-action warnings earn no avoided-loss credit
warning_event.censor: incomplete21-session horizons excluded from precision denominator and separately counted
warning_event.dependence: report episode counts and overlapping horizons; no independent-sample p-values
warning_event.left_censor: A reduced carried state at first evaluation day is left-censored; do not manufacture a new transition or warning.

evaluation.missed_rebounds: For every red entry and red exit, report both net-account returns over5/21/63sessions from previous close through final horizon close, including transition overnight gap, against own base and hold. Report signed benchmark-minus-gate differences and actual exposure. Censor incomplete horizons; future outcomes never set colors.
evaluation.sizing_control: hold is the always-long DAILY sizing reference. Its saved historical figures are NOT results for the new entry-only buy/hold case.
evaluation.fixed_cash_reference: half_hold is fixed half-target daily sizing for standalone-gate comparison; no exactly matched-risk reference or half-EMA claim is supplied.
evaluation.censoring_claim: Compare observed durations only; any censored recovery stays explicitly unresolved, not a shorter eventual recovery claim.
evaluation.primary_pair_implementation: Separate predeclared paired path test, not a relabeling of existing CAGR/drawdown Pareto scores.

resources.timeout_semantics: stop new cases after cap; terminate/preserve a timed-out active process as failed; no silent resume/retry
resources.prior_program: 8/12completed cases are a closed historical program; its4unused slots are not implicitly reused
resources.synthetic_correctness_tests: separate engineering validation, never financial-performance evidence
resources.cash_control: analytical zero-return/zero-cost path under zero cash interest; undefined Sharpe/Calmar, no trading study attempt

readiness.execution: blocked until gate state machine, always-long/fixed-fraction plan support, attribution and guarded audits are implemented/tested; then freeze executable code/dependency hashes before any new market-data case Entry-only holding support also required; the existing daily sizing simulator does not implement literal buy-once hold.
required_tests: exact threshold boundaries and red precedence
five-close staged recovery/reset and warmup continuity
today/future perturbations cannot alter an already scheduled target
no double signal lag or double multiplication
EMA and always-long controls match saved5bp ledgers/trades exactly within1e-7USD ledger tolerance
Decimal reconciliation plus explicit finite/coverage guards for every case
temporal metric parity and event horizon/censoring boundaries
12-case reservations, failure/timeout preservation, immutable cache checks
entry-only initial buy then no discretionary rebalance; preserve dividend cash and common mandatory risk handling
launch_requirements: implementation identity and reviewed exact plan
fresh12-case coordinator reservation and deadline before launch
